title: Detaching an open parent under a completed root fails with a projection error once its only open child was detached
outcome: Detaching an open parent under a completed root fails with a projection error once its only open child was detached
acceptance: Under a completed root, `update PARENT --detach REASON` on an open intermediate parent whose open descendants were all detached (superseded) succeeds and produces an independent successor, or refuses with a typed, actionable refusal naming a supported remedy; it never fails with work_projection_invalid such as 'root work … has no active execution'.

A regression test builds root (completed) → open parent → open child, detaches the child, then detaches the parent, and asserts the outcome above; the existing refusal while an open descendant remains is pinned unchanged.

completion.summary: Fixed completed-root parent detach advisory lookup and guidance. Parent detaches into an independent successor after its open descendants are resolved, preserving completed-root history; open-descendant refusal remains unchanged. Child/parent/list guidance uses admitted waiver and detach candidates.
